author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Hello Avicus Staff,

I've had a break from Avicus for a few weeks and tried out a few other servers. I did this because I really wanted to change my approach to the community of Avicus. I have made new friends on badlion and I have definitely improved my behaviour dramatically. I've learned from my mistakes and I'm would love the chance to be back on Avicus with a fresh mind. I have still been active in the forums and I have stopped my previous poor behaviour. 

I feel a different person from when I was last on Avicus. I feel that I'm now respectful of all staff and members of the server community as I showed to Badlion. I'm missing Avicus and all the friends I have on it. This is really important to me because Avicus is my favourite server by a long way. I realised how much I do love Avicus. Please accept me back into this community.

Regards,

DaCrowMan

title: My ban

replies.author: iKronix_Gaming
replies.body: Hey, I just wanted to know why it was taking a while to reply to my appeal?
replies.body_tagged: Hey, I just wanted to know why it was taking a while to reply to my appeal?

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal. However, if you receive more infractions, you will be banned with a 0% chance of being appealed again.

Regards,
Peacheh
Avicus Network Administrator.
